elements.label: Secrecy
elements.description: Most of my current actions must avoid drawing attention—but this one especially demands careful handling.

elements.label: A Sealed Door
elements.description:
A door sealed layer upon layer with spells and magic—it will not yield easily to any external force, but neither will it leap up to bite anyone.
[Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: An Uncertain Location
elements.description:
My target is somewhere nearby, but I still need to narrow down the location a little more before I can actually get to work.
[Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: Cultists
elements.description: A large faction of mortals armed with rudimentary knowledge of the hidden world—strictly speaking, not even adepts. Against them, I would have many options.

elements.label: Adepts
elements.description: Having answered the riddle of the Stag Door and passed through, these exceptionally gifted mortals are heavily armed with knowledge of the secret world.

elements.label: A Frantic Struggle
elements.description: The battle enters its most critical phase –

elements.label: Cliff
elements.description: The steep and perilous cliff—a trial of will and resolve for those who dare to challenge it.

elements.label: A Crack
elements.description: A narrow crack barely wide enough for a young child to crawl through. Passing through it with any semblance of dignity would clearly require a touch of special skill.

elements.label: A Crossroad
elements.description: Possible paths exist in multitude, yet the right choice has ever only been one.

elements.label: Torrent
elements.description: The path ahead is blocked by a rushing torrent. Only by withstanding its force without yielding can one continue onward.

elements.label: Bitter Cold
elements.description: My movements are slow and stiff. My breath turns to frost. Every step is painfully arduous.

elements.label: Outer-Things
elements.description: The skin of the world has grown thin and fragile. At times, Worms—or something exceedingly akin to them from Nowhere—may slip through unimpeded into the Wake. This shall prove no trivial inconvenience.

elements.label: A Great Seal
elements.description:
A defensive measure specifically designed to counter the Long and other, more powerful beings. Even so, it cannot hinder me forever.
[Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: Ruins
elements.description:
A vast stretch of terrain sealed off by shattered structures and rubble.
[Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: A Necessary Procedure
elements.description:
Due to the combined effects of multiple factors, the shell of my ally is currently in a precarious condition. A minor procedure is necessary.
[Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE
elements.description: Protection capable of defending against Worm and Storm and Bite and Sight and the Eight Principles and the Four Hundred Names.

elements.label: Drowning Curse
elements.description: Known in the ancient eastern realms as 'Call of Brine'. A soul-sinking curse of Heart, its effect akin to plunging the target into the deepest ocean abyss.

elements.label: The Wood
elements.description: The Wood is deep and dark and hides many buried secrets.

elements.label: An Agonized Woman, Who is Consumed by Despair
elements.description: She has lost her radiance and her sense of self – only unending suffering remains. She is the guardian of old no longer; before me stands naught but a pitiful shade.

elements.label: A Puzzling Conundrum
elements.description:
Here is a riddle, a paradox, a question with an inscrutable answer. The secrets of this place have been deliberately destroyed and concealed, and they can only be restored with unconventional thinking or exceptional knowledge
[Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: Chionic Theoplasma
elements.description: This place is protected by the power of one of the chilly Names or Hours, perhaps even a god-from-Nowhere.

elements.label: Pyric Theoplasma
elements.description: This place is protected by the power of one of the incandescent Names or Hours, the gods-from-Steel.

elements.label: Actinic Theoplasma
elements.description: This place is protected by the power of one of the bright Names or Hours, the gods-from-Light.

elements.label: A Gate of the Secret Histories
elements.description: The path runs through a gate that will only appear in the right History.

elements.label: The Path of Atonement
elements.description: A path bristling with dazzling glass thorns that thirst for the blood of the guilty.

elements.label: Ascending Stairs
elements.description: A seemingly endless flight of steep golden stairs. Each step I take is twice as hard as the last.

elements.label: Surging Phantasms
elements.description: A series of bizarre illusions that blur the line between truth and falsehood.

elements.label: Furnace Spark
elements.description: A spark separated from the core of the Forge a hundred years ago, it still burns with unparalleled intensity.

elements.label: Aunt Mopsy
elements.description: A Name of the Mare-in-the-Tree, and the secret guardian of the Monastery of the Fifth Cup. If I can somehow bemuse her, or arouse her greed, I might convince her to help me.

elements.label: Sunset Celia
elements.description: A Name of the Watchman, and the guardian of Crossrow: my mother, my earliest mentor, and a music lover. Her true allegiances remain a mystery. How much has her hidden influence shaped my destiny? Perhaps I will never know. Perhaps it no longer matters.

elements.label: The Sun-in-Rags
elements.description: An Hour which burns still, which is not as it was, who is adorned in gold and red – here he is. This weary and eccentric power has taken an unusual interest in my fate. I do not know whether to feel honoured or afraid.

elements.label: A History-Ending Truth
elements.description: A numen is a powerful truth indeed. Though its words may be contained in writing, in speech, in the minds of the wise, once it has been revealed, it will find a way to be realized. [Being blocked by this obstacle does not end the expedition, though it carries a relatively high chance of leaving traces.]

elements.label: The Moon's Wound
elements.description: Though the Meniscate's light is incomparably beautiful, it is not perfect. Here is her hidden wound.

elements.label: The Horned Axe's Disfavour
elements.description: Flesh stiffens, wounds split open. The judgment of the Horned Axe is rendering this reality ever more severe.

elements.label: The Forge-of-Days' Rage
elements.description: Rage from the Forge simmers in the air, heavy as a hanging maul. A single spark could turn it into a dreadful upheaval.

elements.label: The Red Grail's Delight
elements.description: The cruel gift of the Red Grail resides here—sweet and red—yet to truly touch it brings astonishing agony.

elements.label: The Madrugad's Rigor
elements.description: Blazing as summer's heat, frigid as winter's frost — she who comes before the sun has willed that transformation and stagnation divide the land between them.

elements.label: The Malachite's Contempt
elements.description: The air hangs thick, sweet enough to seem dripping with syrup—so easily it lulls one into overlooking the prickle seeping through the skin. The Malachite's comfort is alluring, and lethal.

elements.label: Meniscate's Disdain
elements.description: The serene radiance of the Meniscate heralds balance—perfect and deathly still: What is within, without; what is without, within.

elements.label: Illusory Radiance
elements.description:
The mesmerizing light has blurred the line between reality and illusion. Until I dispel this illusion, it will prevent me from reaching my objective. 
[While 'Illusory Radiance' exists, you will be unable to start an expedition to the 'Path to the Lake'.]

elements.label: The Velvet's Resentment
elements.description: The fury of the Velvet permeates the shadows, like charcoal smoldering beneath a blanket of ashes. Some things should never be brought into the light; some secrets are meant to stay buried in the earth.

elements.label: The Wolf-Divided's Hatred
elements.description: An odour like tar, like blood, like smouldering gunpowder. The Wolf-Divided's hate boils beneath the air.
